items.title: Delaying Internal Deployments Until After X Days of Safety Testing
items.summary: This post reflects my own takes, and not that of my employer's. This is a simple idea: before a new model can be deployed internally, you must first test it for a minimum, fixed period. You can adjust various axes of this proposal: Duration of the wait: in calendar time, or until you fulfill some condition.
